tasks.subject: Task 1: Add notification_channel to User schema + migration
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Persist the user's channel preference (`"push"`, `"email"`, or `"both"`) on `users`, defaulting existing rows to `"push"`.

**Files:**
- Create: `priv/repo/migrations/20260827100000_add_notification_channel_to_users.exs`
- Modify: `lib/dtu_app/accounts/user.ex:55` (add `@valid_channels`) and `lib/dtu_app/accounts/user.ex:165-168` (extend changeset)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Migration runs forward and back; existing rows get `notification_channel = "push"`.
- [ ] `User.notification_settings_changeset(%{}, %{"notification_channel" => "email"})` returns a valid changeset with `:notification_channel` set to `"email"`.
- [ ] `User.notification_settings_changeset(%{}, %{"notification_channel" => "sms"})` returns a changeset with `:notification_channel` error "must be one of: push, email, both".
- [ ] `User.notification_settings_changeset(%{}, %{})` keeps existing value (no overwrite on empty cast).

**Verify:** `mix ecto.migrate && mix test test/dtu_app/accounts_test.exs:554`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["priv/repo/migrations/20260827100000_add_notification_channel_to_users.exs", "lib/dtu_app/accounts/user.ex", "test/dtu_app/accounts_test.exs"], "verifyCommand": "mix test test/dtu_app/accounts_test.exs", "acceptanceCriteria": ["migration runs forward and back", "valid channels accepted", "invalid channels rejected with inclusion error", "empty cast preserves existing value"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Expose Push.native_enabled?/2
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Stop `Notifications.broadcast/2` from owning the push-fan-out decision. Lift `native_push_enabled?/2` to `DtuApp.Push` so both push and email code paths can ask the same question.

**Files:**
- Modify: `lib/dtu_app/push.ex:71-83`
- Modify: `lib/dtu_app/notifications.ex:162-238`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `Push.native_enabled?(%User{}, %{"event" => "sun_down"})` returns `true` iff `user.notify_sun_down == true`.
- [ ] `Push.native_enabled?/2` accepts both string- and atom-keyed maps.
- [ ] `Push.native_enabled?/2` returns `true` for unknown events and malformed payloads.

**Verify:** `mix test test/dtu_app/push_test.exs test/dtu_app/notifications_test.exs`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/dtu_app/push.ex", "lib/dtu_app/notifications.ex", "test/dtu_app/push_test.exs"], "verifyCommand": "mix test test/dtu_app/push_test.exs", "acceptanceCriteria": ["predicate exposed and tested for all three events plus unknown events", "string- and atom-keyed payload shapes both handled", "existing notifications tests still compile"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Dispatcher + Notifications.broadcast shim
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A new `DtuApp.Notifications.Dispatcher` is the single fan-out point for one notification fire. `Notifications.broadcast/2` becomes a shim that records the history row (with the new `:channel` column) and delegates to `Dispatcher.fire/3`.

**Files:**
- Create: `lib/dtu_app/notifications/dispatcher.ex`
- Modify: `lib/dtu_app/notifications.ex:162-205`
- Create: `lib/dtu_app/emails/connection_email.ex` (stub)
- Create: `lib/dtu_app/emails/sun_up_email.ex` (stub)
- Create: `lib/dtu_app/emails/sun_down_email.ex` (stub)
- Create: `priv/repo/migrations/20260827100001_add_channel_to_notifications.exs`
- Modify: `lib/dtu_app/notifications/notification.ex`
- Create: `test/dtu_app/notifications/dispatcher_test.exs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `Dispatcher.fire/3` calls `Push.deliver/2` only when channel is `push` or `both` AND `Push.native_enabled?/2` says yes.
- [ ] `Dispatcher.fire/3` queues an email only when channel is `email` or `both` AND the user has a confirmed email.
- [ ] History `notifications` row records `channel` matching the user's preference at fire time.
- [ ] Push raising does not abort the email path; email failing does not abort anything else.

**Verify:** `mix test test/dtu_app/notifications_test.exs test/dtu_app/notifications/dispatcher_test.exs`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/dtu_app/notifications/dispatcher.ex", "lib/dtu_app/notifications.ex", "lib/dtu_app/notifications/notification.ex", "priv/repo/migrations/20260827100001_add_channel_to_notifications.exs", "lib/dtu_app/emails/connection_email.ex", "lib/dtu_app/emails/sun_up_email.ex", "lib/dtu_app/emails/sun_down_email.ex", "test/dtu_app/notifications/dispatcher_test.exs"], "verifyCommand": "mix test test/dtu_app/notifications/dispatcher_test.exs", "acceptanceCriteria": ["push path byte-identical via Dispatcher", "email path best-effort and locale-aware", "history row records channel correctly", "failure isolation: push raise does not abort email"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
